Home / About TRIXX

Founded 2016 · Nairobi, Kenya

We started with one house and one idea.

TRIXX was founded in Nairobi in 2016 to build houses that can absorb technology for twenty years without being opened up again. That became a device factory, a property marketplace and an irrigation business.

10 yrs Building in Kenya
640+ Homes completed
300+ Farm plots installed
2,400+ Live listings

Our story

We started with one house and one idea.

In 2016 we finished a single house on Kiambu Road with conduit run to every room, a spare route from the roof to the plant position, and a switchboard labelled in plain language. It cost about 4% more than a conventional build of the same size. Nine years later that house has had three rounds of technology added without a single wall being opened, and the owners have never had to move out for an upgrade.

That 4% is the whole company. Everything TRIXX has built since — the collections, the device schedule, the service spine, the farm controllers — exists to make a building that can absorb change instead of resisting it.

What we actually do

We are three businesses sharing one engineering standard.

  • We build and sell homes. Six architectural collections, each with a fixed device schedule and a build record that goes to the buyer.
  • We list other people's property. Owner listings, identity-checked and physically inspected, with the same 360 tours and floor plans we give our own homes.
  • We run the systems afterwards. Solar, storage, irrigation, metering, security and the five apps that tie them together.

How we work

Three habits explain most of our decisions. We measure before we claim — every saving figure on this site comes from installed systems, not a manufacturer's datasheet. We build for the upgrade, because a house outlives the technology inside it. And we tell buyers which properties we built and which we did not, because a verified badge is worthless if it is not honest.

Working at TRIXX

We hire engineers, surveyors, agronomists and support staff, and we promote from the site teams. Roles are advertised on our LinkedIn page. If you have built something in Kenya with your hands, say so in your application — it carries more weight here than a certificate.

Milestones

Ten years, in order

2016

TRIXX founded in Nairobi

Started with three people, one completed house in Kiambu and a promise to wire every build for the future.

2018

First Swahili Coastal range completed

Six homes in Kilifi and Watamu, and the design language that still defines the coastal collection.

2020

TRIXX Home launched

The first version of the smart-home app shipped to 400 households on our own builds.

2022

Farm solutions and TRIXX Farm

Soil-moisture irrigation moved from a pilot in Nanyuki to a full product line.

2024

Market and Rent launched

The property marketplace opened to owner listings, with identity verification from day one.

2026

Athi River smart-device factory

Opened a local assembly line for hubs, sensors and controllers, cutting lead times to nine days.
